contract.sync_assumed: warp convergence of the 32 lanes, the caller separates calls that reuse the output buffer or the temp storage by a __syncwarp (the harness does)
contract.sync_performed: one redux.min for the threshold, log2(IPT + 1) ballots for the prefix, one __syncwarp between the scatter and the gather, one redux.max per finish round, one redux.max for the fp32 next-word check (redux.add, max and min on the fp32 slow path, redux.add per level and two ballots per item on the overflow fallback), no barriers
contract.n_range: N = 32 x IPT, power of two, 256 to 65536 (bf16) or 32768 (fp32), measured 512 to 2048
contract.type_constraints: float filter on raw keys (bf16 widened by a shift, minus zero normalized to plus zero by one FADD at load), W2 finish word (bf16 16 twiddled key bits above a 16-bit inverted index, exact, fp32 top 32 - log2(capacity) twiddled key bits above the inverted buffer position, idea N4, exact after the tie pass), int32 indices from the striped position
contract.nan_behavior: a NaN never passes the float filter (compare false), the finish word is W2's, focus-set inputs contain no NaN
contract.tie_break_support: inherent (finish word and fallback tickets), both requirements run the same code and measured identical cycles in all 12 cell pairs of batch v4b (1837 vs 1837 at bf16 N 1024 k 32, 5975 vs 5975 at fp32 N 2048 k 64)
contract.sorted_output_support: descending by key on the filter path (fp32 by truncated key with the tie class of the k-th key rewritten in (key, index) order), ticket order on the overflow fallback

correctness.notes: oracle battery passed on every cell of both batches under both requirements, the overflow fallback is exercised by the tie_heavy, pivot_tie, all_equal and sorted cases, signed_zero passes with the load-time normalization.

low_level: The predicate-free bf16 gather (minus zero normalized at load by x + 0.0f, plain sign-fold twiddle without the compare, unconditional loads masked by the sign of p - tot) takes 190 to 400 cycles off every bf16 cell against W5_v3 in the same lock section: N 512 k 16 1140 vs 1312, k 32 1612 vs 1846, k 64 2556 vs 2947, N 1024 k 8 1101 vs 1173, k 16 1337 vs 1556, k 32 1837 vs 2116, k 64 2936 vs 3303, N 2048 k 16 1861 vs 2018, k 32 2485 vs 2675, k 64 4163 vs 4427. fp32 is unchanged within 3 percent either way (its gather had no per-word compare), throughput within 4 percent of v3 except bf16 N 2048 k 16 (1379 vs 1188 Gelem per s).

Registers as v3 (64 at N 512, 127 to 128 at N 1024, 254 to 255 at N 2048, no spill, no local memory), the one FADD per item at load costs nothing visible. Canary 32.001 at start and end, R squared 1.0000 everywhere.

Stacked over the four W5 builds at bf16 N 1024 k 32 (control W2_packed_v3 2481 in every session): base 2162, v2 2279, v3 2116, v4 1837. The phase profile of v3 put the remaining W5-specific fixed cost at about 1400 cycles of which scatter 332 and gather 440, so the v4 gather is near the fp32 level (about 190) and the shared store instructions (about 10 cycles each, 32 per call at IPT 32) are what is left, next to the per-lane top 2 (160) and the ballot prefix (216).
algorithmic: Kill criteria of the W5 card: bf16 N 1024 k 32 at 1837 is under the 1900 threshold (1.35x against the required 1.3x), fp32 N 2048 k 16 at 2293 is under 3300 (1.92x), the 99th percentile candidate count stays inside the finish capacity on every measured input (seed_check: 170 of 256 at k 32, 185 of 256 at k 64). W5 passes both and takes bf16 from k 16 at N 1024 and N 2048, fp32 from k 32 at N 1024 and from k 16 at N 2048, and every throughput cell from k 16. W2_packed_v3 keeps bf16 and fp32 k 8, fp32 N 1024 k 16 and all of N 512 (v4 at N 512 k 32 1612 against W2 1468 across sessions).

Against N7_twolevel (same session, different lock sections): W5_v4 is ahead at every bf16 cell from k 32 (N 1024 k 64 2936 against 4623, N 2048 k 64 4163 against 5371) and at fp32 k 64 (4737 against 3980 is the one fp32 cell N7 keeps at N 1024, with N 2048 k 16 2293 against 2267 a tie).
negative: fp32 does not gain from v4: its gather was already predicate free in v3, so the fp32 cells stay where v3 put them (N 1024 k 16 0.87x against W2, the only focus-band cell W5 loses).
surprises: One FADD per item (x + 0.0f) replaces a compare and a select per gathered word and a position predicate per slot and is worth 13 to 15 percent of the whole call at bf16 IPT 16 to 32: predicate pressure, not instruction count, set the cost of the gather as it set the cost of the count in v2.
open_questions: The shared store instructions of the scatter (about 10 cycles each on one warp) are the largest remaining W5-specific cost: two candidates per 64-bit store when the lane's run start is even, or a fused count-and-scatter into per-lane private runs with a prefix-free gather, are the candidates.

The per-lane top 2 (160 cycles at IPT 32) and the ballot prefix (216) are the next two items, the first by a cheaper pair tree, the second by fewer count bits (a per-lane count above 15 means the 16x2 bound is loose and could go to the fallback).
N 4096 cells (IPT 128), the k 128 band against N7, and a GB200 card are not measured.

verification.notes: verify-W5 rerun 2026-10-25 16:00Z on umbriel-b200-028, the card's node (B200, nvcc 13.4.92, sm_100, clone dc8e2466c129), adapters and controls rebuilt from the W5 worktree at cbe08213ed (W5_v4.cuh, W5_impl_v4.cuh, W5_impl_v3.cuh, W5_impl_v2.cuh, W5_impl.cuh, W5_v3.cuh, W2_packed_v3.cuh and W2_impl.cuh byte identical to the card commit dfd5a1ee14 and to the W2 card commit 28239d1a4b), one lease (holder verify-W5), both card batches rerun in full with their own lock section, canaries first and last: state/results/verify-W5/W5_v4_vs_W2_packed_v3_focus_v4b_verify_20261025_155854.json (48 cells, both requirements) and W5_v4_vs_W5_v3_focus_v4a_verify_20261025_155956.json (48 cells). Canaries 32.00098 cycles per op at both ends of both batches (thr_us 3775.0 to 3775.9), oracle 13 cases per adapter per cell (4 random seeds plus the 9 battery patterns) passed on variant and control in every cell, self-test true, controls named and in the same process and lock section, no A/A, no retries. Every latency cell reproduces the card to the cycle on variant and control: bf16 N 1024 k 32 1837.0 against W2_packed_v3 2481.0 (1.35x, card 1837 and 2481), k 16 1337.0 against 1485.0, k 64 2936.0 against 7308.2 (2.49x), N 2048 k 16 1861.0 against 2377.0, k 32 2485.0 against 4380.8, k 64 4163.0 against 10071.2 (2.42x), fp32 N 1024 k 16 1773.7 against 1547.0 (0.87x, the one loss, reproduced), k 32 2740.6 against 3059.0, k 64 4737.3 against 6774.0, N 2048 k 16 2292.9 against 4391.4 (1.92x), k 32 3296.3 against 7354.0 (2.23x), k 64 5975.3 against 10187.9. the prefer_smaller_index cells are identical to the not_guaranteed cells to the cycle in all 12 pairs, and the W5_v4 latency kernels of the two requirements have identical instruction streams (8402 SASS lines each, cuobjdump, equal except for the mangled name). Throughput within 0.3 percent of the card in all 48 variant values (bf16 N 1024 k 16 1051 against W2 802 Gelem/s, 1.31x. N 2048 k 64 717 against 255 to 261, 2.75x to 2.81x. fp32 N 2048 k 64 516 against 229 to 233). Against W5_v3 (batch v4a) every latency value reproduces to the cycle (bf16 N 1024 k 32 1837.0 against 2116.0, k 64 2936.0 against 3303.5, N 2048 k 32 2485.0 against 2675.1, fp32 N 2048 k 32 3296.3 against 3296.3), throughput within 0.3 percent. Registers, spill, stack, STL, LDL and instruction counts identical to the card in every cell: 64 at N 512, 127 to 128 at N 1024, 254 to 255 at N 2048, no spill, no stack frame, no STL or LDL in any W5_v4 kernel (ptxas and cuobjdump of the rebuilt binaries). Anti-DCE: chain minima strictly increasing, R squared 1.0000 in every latency cell, slope_raw at least 4x slope_noop, outputs consumed by the harness sink, both kernels in the same process. Correctness: the oracle battery (tie_heavy, sorted_asc, sorted_desc, pivot_tie, all_equal, signed_zero, inf_denorm, quantized_random, relu_quantized) ran under both requirements and passed in every cell, so the fallback (w5::radix_fallback, exact bit-serial radix select with ballot tickets in index order, prefer_smaller_index by construction) and the fp32 tie class pass (w5v2::tie_check on full keys and source indices) are exercised. prefer_smaller_index is exact by construction on the fast path (bf16: unique word of twiddled key above the inverted source index, fp32: tie class of the k-th truncated key rewritten by (full key, index)), and the load-time x + 0.0f normalization is in the SASS (FADD Rn, RZ, Rm per item, 135 FADD in the bf16 N 1024 k 32 latency kernel against 71 in W5_v3's), which the exactness on signed zeros depends on: a 32-seed signed_zero oracle run under prefer_smaller_index (state/results/verify-W5/W5_v4_vs_W2_packed_v3_focus_sz32_W5_v4_20261025_160950.json) passes all 42 cases in each of the 12 cells (bf16 and fp32, N 1024 and 2048, k 16 to 64) where W5_v3 fails every cell (see the W5_v3 card). Overflow: approaches/W5/seed_check.cu rebuilt and rerun on the node reproduces the card (worst 185 of 256 candidates at bf16 and fp32 N 1024 k 64, 170 of 256 at k 32, 284 of 512 at N 4096 k 128, no measured input overflows), and a verifier variant counting in key space, which is what the v2 to v4 filter does on bf16 (every item at or above the threshold key passes, ties included, where seed_check counts unique words), finds at most 3 more candidates (167 against 164 at N 2048 k 64) and no overflow on any of the 16 measured inputs of any cell. the simulated overflow rate at k 64 D 8 is 3e-4 per call (sim_gj: max 259 of 256 in 4000 trials), so a long random workload will take the fallback occasionally, which is correct but costs a radix select. CAVEATS on wording, not on numbers: (1) the W2_packed_v3 throughput control at bf16 N 1024 k 64 not_guaranteed reads 197.0 Gelem/s in the card against 208.7 in the rerun and 208.8 in the card's own prefer_smaller_index cell, so that cell's 2.48x is 2.34x (the other 47 controls are within 1.6 percent). (2) the v4 over v3 gain is 3 to 14 percent on the bf16 latency cells, not 13 to 15 percent on every one (13 to 14 percent at IPT 16 and 32 with k 16 to 64, 6 to 8 percent at N 2048 and at k 8, 53 to 391 cycles rather than 190 to 400), and fp32 N 2048 k 8 is 4.1 percent slower than v3 rather than within 3 percent. (3) the W2_packed_v3 control values at k 32 to 64 and IPT 32 to 64 are 10 to 26 percent above the W2 card's values on umbriel-b200-047 (bf16 N 1024 k 64 7308 against 6628, N 2048 k 64 10071 against 9237, fp32 N 2048 k 64 10188 against 8097) and agree with verify-W2's rerun on umbriel-b200-091 (7425, 10238, 10346), the node term documented in the W2_packed_v3 verification, so the ratios above 2x at those cells are node dependent while the kill cell bf16 N 1024 k 32 (W2 2481 on every node) is not. Verdict: verified, all claims reproduced, both kill criteria hold (1837 under 1900 at 1.35x, 2293 under 3300 at 1.92x).
